notes: Partial scan of Ontario F-150 inventory. Search was location-based (Mississauga, Ontario) rather than province-wide, returning 50 results. Collected detailed vehicle information including VINs and vehicle history summaries for 10 representative vehicles (20% sample). All Carfax report links resulted in error pages when accessed directly, but summary information (accident history, ownership, service records) was visible on Clutch vehicle detail pages and captured. Discovered listing IDs represent vehicles visible in filtered search results. Scan marked incomplete (scan_complete: false) because Clutch.ca uses city/postal-code based search rather than province-wide inventory access, so complete Ontario coverage cannot be verified.
source: Browser Agent manual Clutch.ca scan: Mississauga, Ontario location search with year filter 2021-2026 applied, searched ford-f150 model. Search URL: https://www.clutch.ca/cars/ford-f-150?yearLow=2021
